build_vqmodel: build a VQModel with encoder, decoder, and vector quantizer for image autoencoding
encode_vqmodel: encode an input image through the VQModel encoder and quantization layers
decode_autoencoderkl: decode a latent vector using the AutoencoderKL decoder to reconstruct an image
init_from_ckpt_vqmodel: initialize a VQModel from a checkpoint file with optional ignored keys
create_identityfirststage: create an IdentityFirstStage module that passes inputs through unchanged for passthrough encoding
